notes.title: Crop farm improvements
notes.notes:
-Fixeded crop farm production flow
-Sheep and goats will now destroy crops, so keep them away (a dog will be added later for this task)

Other fixes:
-Fixed save/load state for breeders

Other improvements:
-Springboard can now launch lightweight characters higher (all depends on the weight (including cargo) of both characters  using the springboard)

notes.title: Improved the tutorial
notes.notes:
Fixed
-Performance issues where invisible lemons, apples and woodlogs in each tree caused massive collision detections and low frame rate on fast speed
-Quest help signs ar no longer clickable untill reached by a Summiteer
-Some translations fixed or added
-Added empty hands icon above structure when a worker without tools is needed
-Improved sawmill quest logic

notes.notes: Added a tutorial level and lots of bugs fixed
